name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
label: Quest

intro: Fleet Master Seahorn trusts a loyal ally of the Blackwater Raiders with striking the Bloodsail Buccaneers' so-called southern command post on the Wild Shore. Recovering their charts and written orders will show exactly what those pirates are up to.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Crazz speaks highly of your dedication to the Blackwater Raiders. I am going to trust you with a mission of extreme importance to the fleet.

Infiltrate the so-called southern command post the Bloodsail Buccaneers have established on the Wild Shore. Raid the encampment. Bring me their charts along with their written orders. We shall see exactly what those scum are up to.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ahoy, friend. What word do you bring of the Bloodsail encampment to the south?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Perfect, friend. Now that we know their plan, it's just a matter of time.
And to think the fools have dropped anchor just off the cape....
